result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my overall recommendation is **Xero Payroll** for most businesses, particularly if you want payroll and accounting in one place.

However, there are a few alternatives that may be better depending on your number of employees and how complicated your payroll is.

## Best payroll software for small businesses

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall)

From approximately \$37/month

- Easy to use and set up.
- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- STP reporting and super payments.
- Employee payslips and leave management.

Best if you want an all-in-one business accounting solution.

[Xero website and pricing](https://www.xero.com/au/accounting-software/payroll/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for small teams)

Payroll Only approximately \$20/month for up to 4 employees

- Straightforward payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Super and leave management.
- Good accounting integration.

Particularly attractive if you have four or fewer employees and want standalone payroll.

[MYOB comparison and pricing](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero**

(Best for award compliance)

Approximately \$10 per employee/month, with a 10-user minimum

- Modern Award interpretation.
- Payroll and HR management.
- Employee onboarding.
- Rostering and leave management options.

Particularly good for hospitality, retail and businesses with different employee pay rates.

[Employment Hero comparison](https://rankite.com/blog/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v2DxdxtjjvEmcT175Hs6YVBjgbAAlKMZDR6USs-77ApdWW6sbAFow9cQJv_MT97jB9zjE3wPxOpKSO9gcLLxLfFypeZvyP5eJvDL5WGyfBsSIqIhU81GbrWMoq4pqjRGs2-V3Eb0qoi-t3xsMSUPgetkp-nB9-Vn5YkmqvxZsrEUOfyJgwiq9_ZT3tLhuZte?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Payroller**

(Best budget option)

From approximately \$3.99 per employee/month on annual billing

- Simple payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Payslips and super management.
- Suitable for very small businesses.

Good if you just need to pay a handful of employees without a full accounting package.

[Payroller pricing comparison](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 employees, straightforward payroll | Xero |
| 1–4 employees, payroll only | MYOB |
| Hospitality or retail | Employment Hero |
| Lowest-cost payroll | Payroller |
| Growing business with HR needs | Employment Hero |


One important consideration in Australia: make sure your software supports STP Phase 2, PAYG withholding, superannuation and your employees' applicable Modern Awards. Payday super requirements also changed on 1 July 2026.
